title: The market cooled off in Central Texas so a lot of homeowners assume their equity cooled off with it
description:
The market cooled off in Central Texas, so a lot of homeowners assume their equity cooled off with it. Most of the time, it didn't.
Here's the piece that gets missed. Headlines track list prices and averages. Your equity is your own number, tied to what you bought at, what you owe, and what your specific home would sell for right now. Those are three different things, and only one of them lands in your account.
Prices easing off the 2022 peak is real. You're not wrong to feel it. But easing off a peak is not the same as losing what you built over the years you owned the place.
The only way to know your real number is to run it, not guess it off Zillow. Some of you have more room than you think. A few of you have less, and it's better to know that now than at the closing table.
